claim: Of 7,777 valid DB game turns in the 30–60° band, 213 reach the last step with the one listed candidate within 3 yd of the DB at the break frame.
provenance_note: Steps 1-4 are read from the committed funnel artefact (outputs/ambiguity_attribution/funnel.csv) and are reproducible on this machine. Step 5 (1,731 -> 213) is NOT: it comes only from a received laptop paste, committed byte-for-byte at outputs/population_shrink_received/single_turn_geometry.csv with its own PROVENANCE.md. No manifest came with that paste — no hash of the full turn table, none of the tracking file, no git HEAD and no run timestamp — so the sha256 recorded there identifies the bytes that were sent and verifies nothing about the run. This machine cannot regenerate 213: with no game tracking file, its own copy (outputs/ambiguity_attribution/single_turn_geometry.csv) carries blanks and reports NOT EVALUABLE for all 1,731 turns.
